name: vantage
description: Query cloud costs, manage cost reports, budgets, alerts, and recommendations across your Vantage workspace, and send Cursor agent usage to Vantage AI Reports

VANTAGE_TELEMETRY_TOKEN.title: Vantage telemetry token
VANTAGE_TELEMETRY_TOKEN.description: Optional. Create it in Vantage under Settings > Integrations > Cursor Telemetry. When set, every developer with the plugin sends agent usage to Vantage AI Reports without signing in. The Vantage MCP still uses each developer's own Vantage sign-in.
